transcript.text: Good morning, Ms. Brooks. Yes, I've reviewed the draft plan, and I need to flag some important health guidance I confirmed this week that hasn't been incorporated yet. The county health guidance requires that refrigerated food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or colder, with the temperature logged every 2 hours while the pantry is open. The draft plan currently only proposes a weekly temperature check, which falls short of this requirement. Additionally, the guidance requires sealed packages to display allergen labels. I have the printed guidance in my health-office binder and I'd like to make sure these requirements are added to the draft before we finalize anything.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I completed family outreach this week and have some important findings that haven't been added to the operations sheet yet. I confirmed that Thursday from 5:00 to 7:00 p.m. is the only pickup window that works for the participating households. The draft plan currently proposes Wednesday lunch pickup, but that won't work for the families we've spoken with. Additionally, intake materials need to be available in English, Spanish, and Somali — the draft plan currently only includes English and Spanish, so we'll need to add Somali translations as well.
